title: Music for All: Representational Bias and Cross-Cultural Adaptability of Music Generation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the geographic and genre representation in 152 music datasets to reveal the severe under-representation of non-Western music, and evaluating the cross-cultural adaptability of music generation models on low-resource cultural genres (Hindustani Classical and Turkish Makam) using automated audio quality metrics (FAD, FD, KLD, PSNR) alongside an arena-style human evaluation framework based on Bloom's Taxonomy.
